summary: A minimalistic and strategic tower defense idle game with incremental upgrades.
description:
Neat Nexus is a tower defense and strategy game, a simple but not easy defense game.

Try to stop your enemy and use an arsenal of towers and tricks to keep the enemy from reaching your base.

If you are looking for a new and exciting strategy game to challenge your skills and engage your mind, look no further than Neat Nexus, the novel tower defense experience!
With hundreds of levels with incremental difficulty, this customisable defense game will put your mind and planning to test. 

In this addictive game, you’ll build intricate mazes of towers to stop armies of red invaders from conquering your world. With 100+ levels to beat, relaxing music and simplistic yet captivating graphics that won’t overload your device, Neat Nexus offers a challenging yet immersive gameplay experience that will keep you coming back for more, with more levels coming every month.

This tower defense game has everything you need to strategize and succeed in your defense, with different towers and a progression system that doesn’t make your life easy. Upgrade your towers, plan your defense, and make the game faster to power your way through your enemies!

Unlock the following towers and defend your territory:
Cannon Tower - A purple, medium-power tower with a high fire rate
Range Tower - Green, with low damage but hits multiple targets
Slow Tower - Blue, applies a slow debuff but deadly if well placed
Splash tower - A red tower with a low fire rate but Splash Damage
Buff Tower - Yellow, increases the fire rate of nearby towers
Laser Tower - Orange, low rate but can reach any enemy on the map

So if you’re looking for a new and exciting way to engage your mind and hone your strategic skills, download Neat Nexus today and start defending our world against the invaders! With its addictive gameplay, relaxing atmosphere, and engaging design, this tower defense game is sure to become your new favorite mobile gaming experience.

Try it now and see for yourself why Neat Nexus is the ultimate tower defense game for strategy game enthusiasts and brick breaker inspired game fans alike!

WHY DO YOU HAVE TO PLAY NEAT NEXUS?

Join the excitement with our strategy game. Test your skills and improve along the way. With plenty of incredible and enjoyable moments, it is a thrilling tower defense experience.

With this game, you can enjoy a simple yet charming tower defense experience that’s perfect for players of all skill levels and device types.

Have fun with this new title from Infinity Games, an expert in minimal and relaxing gameplay! We look forward to bringing you more and more features in future updates.

Now available on Google Play Pass – enjoy the full experience with no ads or locked content!

Check us out at: https://infinitygames.io
